jobs.title: Creative AI Lead (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
WIR SIND WIETHE

Wiethe gehört zu den führenden Content-Produktionsunternehmen Europas und ist Marktführer in Deutschland. Für internationale Marken wie adidas, Y-3, Tchibo, C&A, FC Bayern München und Peek & Cloppenburg entwickeln und produzieren wir Content auf höchstem Qualitätsniveau.

Mit rund 250 Mitarbeitenden an unseren Standorten Bremen und Osnabrück produzieren wir jährlich über 5 Millionen Bilder, mehr als 20.000 Filme und mehrere Tausend AI Assets.

Unsere Kompetenz verbindet Fotografie, Film, Generative AI und CGI. Was uns besonders macht: Wir denken Content nicht in einzelnen Kampagnen, sondern in skalierbaren, technologisch gestützten Produktionsprozessen – mit höchsten Ansprüchen an Qualität, Effizienz und Konsistenz.

Generative AI ist ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Wachstumsstrategie. Wir investieren konsequent in neue Technologien, intelligente Workflows und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktionsmöglichkeiten.

Dafür suchen wir erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Teams führen, Kunden begeistern und unser weiteres Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten.

DEINE ROLLE

Als Creative AI Lead (m|w|d)
übernimmst Du eine zentrale kreative Rolle in unserem wachsenden AI-Bereich.

Du verantwortest die kreative Entwicklung anspruchsvoller AI-Projekte für führende internationale Marken und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Ergebnis. Dabei verbindest Du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Bildsprache und Markenwelten mit fundierter praktischer Erfahrung im Umgang mit Generative AI.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung außergewöhnlicher visueller Konzepte, Bildwelten und kreativer AI-Lösungen, die Markenidentität, gestalterischen Anspruch und neue technologische Möglichkeiten miteinander verbinden.

Du bist kreative Instanz, fachlicher Lead, Sparringspartner unserer Kunden und Impulsgeber für die kreative Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Projekte.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Kreative Konzeption: Entwicklung und fachliche Führung innovativer GenAI-Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und unterschiedliche Content-Formate.
AI Art Direction: Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Look & Feel, Bildsprache, visuellen Systemen und kreativen Qualitätsstandards für AI-gestützte Produktionen.
Hands-on AI Creation: Eigenständiges Testen und Kombinieren generativer AI-Tools und Modelle sowie deren gezielter Einsatz in Bild- und Bewegtbildproduktionen.
Markenübersetzung: Übertragung von Markenidentitäten, Briefings und kreativen Leitideen in eigenständige, reproduzierbare GenAI-Ansätze und Bildwelten.
Kreative Projektführung: Fachliche Führung und kreative Weiterentwicklung der AI-Projekte gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Kreativ-Teams aus AI Artists, Art Direction, Design, CGI, Foto, Motion und weiteren Disziplinen.
Kreative Qualität: Sicherstellung einer durchgehend hohen gestalterischen Qualität, einer starken visuellen Idee und konsistenter Markenwirkung – auch über größere Asset-Mengen und Kampagnen hinweg.
Kundenverantwortung: Souveräne Beratung und Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kunden auf Senior-Level – von der kreativen und strategischen Beratung bis zur Präsentation und Umsetzung.
Creative Technology: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Production und Technology, um kreative Ideen in technisch belastbare und wirtschaftlich realisierbare Produktionsansätze zu übersetzen.
Innovation und Weiterentwicklung: Kontinuierliche Identifikation neuer Modelle, kreativer Technologien und visueller Trends sowie deren Übersetzung in neue Bildsprachen, Formate und Content-Konzepte.
Wissenstransfer: Aufbau und Weitergabe kreativer Best Practices und Standards für den professionellen Einsatz von Generative AI.

UNSERE ERWARTUNGEN

Was Du Mitbringen Solltest

Mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung in Art Direction, Creative Direction, Design, visueller Kommunikation, Creative Technology oder vergleichbaren kreativen Disziplinen.
Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit generativer AI in professionellen kreativen Projekten und Content-Produktionen.WIETHE CONTENT / CAREERS
Creative AI Lead
Ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Gespür und einen sehr hohen Anspruch an Bildsprache, Komposition, Licht, Styling, Materialität und visuelle Qualität.
Ein überzeugendes Portfolio, das Deine kreative Handschrift, Dein Markenverständnis und den professionellen Einsatz generativer AI zeigt.
Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Konzeption und fachlichen Steuerung anspruchsvoller kreativer Projekte mit unterschiedlichen Beteiligten.
Die Fähigkeit, Markenanforderungen und kreative Briefings in eigenständige visuelle Konzepte und Bildwelten zu übersetzen.

Was Zusätzlich Von Vorteil Ist

Kenntnisse aus Fashion, Lifestyle, E-Commerce, Werbung oder der Agenturwelt.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Eine zentrale kreative Lead-Rolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Kreation.
Die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Handschrift unserer AI-Projekte maßgeblich mitzuprägen und neue Bildwelten für führende internationale Marken zu entwickeln.

Modernste technologische Infrastruktur und die Freiheit, neue kreative Technologien nicht nur zu erproben, sondern in realen Produktionen einzusetzen.

READY TO SHAPE THE NEXT LEVEL OF AI CONTENT PRODUCTION?

Du möchtest Generative AI nicht nur anwenden, sondern neue visuelle Möglichkeiten erschließen, außergewöhnliche Markenwelten entwickeln und den kreativen Einsatz von AI auf das nächste Level bringen?

Conscious of the demands placed on today’s modern woman, Jessica designs each piece to stand out, but also to work effortlessly within a client’s lifestyle and existing wardrobe.

What’s the role?

Own the creative for your product stream: Lead the creative response from initial concept through to delivered assets, working closely with Product Marketing to understand the customer, proposition and commercial objective.
Turn insight into ideas: Develop creative concepts grounded in customer understanding and business objectives, going beyond simply responding to a brief.
Strengthen the brief: Partner with Product Marketing early in the process to challenge, test and improve briefs before creative production begins.
Create personalised experiences: Design creative for specific audiences, lifecycle moments and channels rather than relying on one asset adapted everywhere.
Design for performance: Develop creative variants with clear testing objectives and use audience, channel and campaign performance insights to continually improve the work.
Build a creative learning loop: Use results from previous campaigns to inform future ideas, helping the team understand what worked, what didn’t and what to do differently next time.
Present and sell your ideas: Confidently present creative to teams and senior stakeholders, clearly explaining the thinking and commercial rationale behind the work.
Bring stakeholders on the journey: Involve stakeholders throughout the creative process, responding constructively to challenge while protecting the strength and intent of the idea.
Become part of the business: Work as an embedded member of your Product Marketing team, building deep knowledge of the product stream so you can contribute when the problem is being shaped, not only when the brief arrives.
Stay hands-on with the craft: Design work yourself and art direct through to delivery when specialist creative expertise or external production is required.
Design across channels: Create campaign and product creative across digital, social, web and landing pages, video, in-branch, print and colleague channels.
Direct specialist creative: Brief motion, video and copy specialists and provide clear, practical creative direction and feedback that strengthens the final work.
Use AI as part of the craft: Bring AI into your everyday creative workflow to explore ideas, generate variants and adapt work across formats and languages while maintaining strong creative judgement.
Build smarter AI workflows: Develop reusable prompts, references and creative set-ups that produce stronger, more on-brand output and share your learnings to help the wider team improve.

Practical experience using AI within your creative process and a genuine appetite to experiment with new tools and approaches.
Experience designing for digital and web alongside campaign and print creative.
An understanding of performance creative, including variants, structured testing and using results to improve future work.
The ability to work successfully as an embedded creative partner within a business team rather than operating from a central creative queue.
Strong ownership, taking creative work from the first conversation through to the final delivered asset.

Experience working within regulated or governed environments is an advantage.

Personalised & Targeted Creative

Because the best creative doesn’t start with a brief. It starts with understanding the customer and the opportunity.

jobs.title: AI Native Creative Strategist - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
jobs.location: Ajman, Ajman Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

This isn’t another content job.
Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

OUR MISSION

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

Short history

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy
Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery
Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
Deliver what you pitch.
❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
Build the Content Factory: humans and agents
Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
Fuel the Growth Engine
Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.
Go global, and keep the soul
We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native:
you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍

Experience :

Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits :

Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

❌ If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

❌ If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

❌ If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

Growth & Ambition

> 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Competitive Salary

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

Impact & Meaning

> Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
> Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

> 😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
> 🗽 Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
> 🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
> 🧍‍♀️ Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
> 💻 Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
> 🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)
> 📚 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that
> 🔥 Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

How To Apply 📃

⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀

HIRING PROCESS 📃

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

💻 A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

🫵🚀 Welcome aboard!

Abou

Company Description

At Saatchi & Saatchi Health, we believe in making the impossible possible in health. We partner with our clients to turn complexity into clarity, ideas into impact, and ambition into real-world outcomes. By combining creativity, data, and technology, we create work that doesn’t just reach people--it moves them, connects with them, and makes a difference in their lives. Because when our people bring curiosity and courage to the work, we unlock new possibilities for our clients, and better outcomes for the patients they serve. We’re here to push what health can be. And to make it matter.

Overview

The Associate Creative Director (art) is involved in the development of creative concepts, working with all disciplines in the agency including copywriters and designers to build cohesive and effective campaigns.

Their focus is on the visual design and art direction of advertising campaigns. They ensure the visual design aligns with the overall creative direction and strategy of the campaign, and that it effectively communicates the desired message to the target audience.

As a close ally of the Creative Director, they are stepping into a managerial role to mentor team members, especially art directors and designers. In addition, they oversee the production of the visual elements of the campaign, ensuring they are executed to the highest standards.

The Associate Creative Director, Art is responsible for leading the creative work. This leadership role includes assigning teams, inspiring those teams to consistently produce exceptional concepts and final work, and working closely with account management to ensure that our clients are satisfied with the quality of our creative work.

And now, we’re looking for you!
The role holder plans and delivers 6PM's content productions — campaign and seasonal shoots, e-com assets and social content (to an extent) — and manages the freelancers, crews and suppliers required for them. Concept and visual language are owned by Brand. This role is accountable for feasibility, cost, resourcing, scheduling, rights compliance and on-time delivery of finished assets.

Planning and pre-production

Translate creative concepts from Brand into production plans, schedules and budgets, including feasibility feedback at concept stage.

Source and book crew: photographers, directors, DoPs, stylists, hair and make-up, set designers, production assistants.

Run casting and talent booking with agencies, and scout, secure and contract locations and studios.

Organise equipment, catering, transport, permits for shoot locations where required, and all call sheets and shoot documentation.

Production

Ensure the agreed shot list and asset requirements per channel are covered before wrap.

Maintain duty of care on set: crew working hours, equipment and rigging safety, rules for minors on set, insurance cover.

Resolve issues on set and decide on schedule or scope changes within the approved budget.

Deliver finished assets in the formats, ratios and deadlines required by each channel.

Maintain asset organisation and handover so material is findable and reusable, including archive and metadata discipline.

Build and maintain the freelancer, studio and supplier bench, including rate cards and framework agreements.

Control production budgets, track committed versus actual spend, and report variances to the Brand & Marketing Team.

Run day-to-day operation of the in-house studio: booking and scheduling across Marketing, Brand and E-commerce, set-up and reset between productions, and ordering studio stock and consumables.

Own the equipment inventory — cameras, lenses, lighting, grip, audio, computers and storage — including what we hold, where it is and who has it out.

Keep equipment production-ready: cleaning, calibration, firmware, repairs, warranty and insurance claims, and replacement of damaged kit.

Plan equipment investment against production needs, recommend purchases, and decide rent versus buy per production.

Essential

4 to 6 years in content production, agency or brand side, with photo and film experience.

Has independently produced campaign shoots end to end, from brief to delivered assets.

Independent budget responsibility: builds production budgets, tracks them and delivers close to plan.

Established crew, studio, post and casting network in DACH.

Working knowledge of post-production workflow: edit, grade, retouch, versioning, delivery specs per channel.

Solid grasp of usage rights, buyouts, model and location releases and music licensing.

On-set and in-studio duty of care: working hours, equipment and rigging safety, electrical safety, rules for minors, insurance.

Experience with talent, models, agencies and creators, including riders and advancing.

Understanding of streetwear, fashion and music, and of the 6PM community.

Willingness to escalate and to stop a shoot on safety or feasibility grounds.

Experience running or working day to day in a studio environment, including booking, set-up and keeping it production-ready.

Hands-on equipment knowledge: camera systems, lenses, lighting and grip, audio and storage, plus what breaks and what it costs to fix.

German fluent, English confident.

Preferred

Has set up or scaled an in-house studio, including kit selection and workflow.

Experience producing content at live formats such as drops, pop-ups or shows.

E-commerce and product photography at volume.

Own shooting, editing, grading or retouching ability for fast turnarounds.

Experience with asset management systems and delivery pipelines.

Productions outside DACH.

Formal education is not a selection criterion. Assessment is based on delivered
productions.

Modern office in Berlin, complimentary drinks & work-from-home Fridays

Contribution towards a gym membership as well as various mobility benefits

Individual training and development opportunities to support your professional and personal growth

Regular team events and incentives

Flexible working hours based on trust within a motivated team

Attractive salary package with a variable compensation component

Analyze client briefs, tender requirements, and brand guidelines to extract core messaging and strategic proposal objectives.

Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, and experiential designers to align proposal narratives with technical feasibility and project budgets.
Establish and maintain a centralized library of reusable proposal templates, pitch frameworks, case studies, and graphic assets.
Leverage prompt engineering and AI workflows to drastically accelerate content creation and visual production without sacrificing creative quality.
Infuse bespoke human creativity, brand refinement, and detailed art direction into AI-generated visuals for polished, professional outputs.
Continuously test and integrate emerging AI tools and proposal design workflows into the company’s pitch pipeline.

Qualifications & Experience

3–5 years of background experience crafting proposals specifically for an events technology agency or an events & exhibitions agency.

Your degree, or your number of years for its own sake. What matters is that your ideas deliver, whether the goal is sales, awareness or a launch.

Du übernimmst die kreative Verantwortung für Ad Creatives und Landingpages ganzer Kundenaccounts und entscheidest eigenständig über Design, Story und Messaging.

Du willst mit erfahrenen Leuten die Creatives bauen, über die führende B2B-Unternehmen fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets skalieren.

Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team.

- Work with the performance marketing team on incrementality and lift testing to figure out how much of a
result actually came from the creative versus targeting or bidding
- Keep an eye on new and emerging ad channels, and make the call on when it's worth building creative
strategy for one
- Build and maintain a framework connecting creative variables (hook type, format, messaging angle) to
CTR, CVR, CAC, and ROAS
- Deliver clear, actionable reports for stakeholders

Required Qualifications
- 3+ years in creative strategy, performance marketing, or similar, with ownership over the strategy, ideally
in B2C or D2C ecommerce
- Hands-on understanding of how platforms like Meta Advantage+ and Google Performance Max actually
score, learn from, and prioritize creative assets
- Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating strategic thinking behind creative campaigns
- Solid grasp of creative testing methodology: statistical significance, test design, and knowing when a test
is underpowered
- Comfortable working directly with performance data (CTR, CVR, CAC, ROAS, frequency) to make and
defend creative decisions, and willing to drop a “great idea” when the numbers say otherwise
- English fluency required, with German being an added advantage

Preferred Qualifications
- Background in consumer electronics, gaming, or creator-economy brands
- Experience briefing and directing UGC creators
- Proven track record handling mid-to-high six-figure budgets and delivering strong ROI
- Fluent in the current AI creative toolkit (generative image/video, dubbing/localization) and AI-powered
bidding — enough to brief, direct, and quality-check the work, not necessarily to operate every tool
- Solid understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, and first-party data strategies

Who You Are
- You think about creatives systematically with a framework behind it. When someone asks why a piece of
creative is winning, your answer starts with a number. You're fine being the person who has to explain why
a test result doesn't mean what everyone in the room assumes it means. When AI can generate fifty
variants in an afternoon, you're the one who knows which three are actually worth running and which
ideas aren't worth making at all.

- Ownership over the creative strategy for campaigns with meaningful budget and visibility across the
business
- Elgato is genuinely open to experimentation. We back bold ideas and aren't afraid to go a little off-script
when it makes sense.
- Our products are used and loved by millions of creators around the world.
- You'll be part of a well-resourced team within the Corsair Group, while still working at the speed of a
brand that moves like a startup.
- Competitive package, hybrid working in Munich, and gear discounts you'll actually use
